_ms: Each answer's ms: roads is as recorded on 2026-10-14; lorryPark, hydrogen, weatherLand, transit, charging and parking are the round trip of one tools/call to mcp.viafrei.de measured by a client on 2026-11-05, so they include the network. No page prints it.
